text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,440.8, up 1.68% on the day and 3.02% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.58% (5‑day +2.93%). Advances outnumbered declines 401 to 92, giving a breadth score of 44.5 in a neutral zone. The move was fairly broad, with 11 stocks hitting 52‑week highs and only seven making new lows.  

Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹3,114.68 cr, whereas domestic institutions (DIIs) sold ₹392.2 cr. Over the last five days FIIs have accumulated ₹8,472.7 cr and DIIs ₹2,669 cr, marking a fourth consecutive day of FII buying. The leading sectors were Pharma, Infrastructure, Oil & Gas and PSU banks; IT and Private banks were weakening. In options, Nifty’s put‑call ratio (PCR) is 1.66, indicating more put interest, with a max‑pain level around 23,250 and a call wall at 24,000. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 0.96, call wall at 57,000 and put wall at 58,000.  

Watch the Nifty pivot zone: support at 23,284.97 (S1) and pivot at 23,362.88; resistance at 23,518.72 (R1). For Bank Nifty, key levels are S1 54,707.35, pivot 54,876.85 and R1 55,171.7. A break below the Nifty support could test the 20‑day EMA around 23,300, while a hold above the pivot may allow a move toward the call wall at 24,000. Keep an eye on upcoming Q2 earnings from ITC, Marico and Reliance, and any RBI government‑securities auction that could affect liquidity.
